reviewItem.question: Does "⚠️ Remove 3rd party lua plugin support (#11821) ⚠️ This removes the following configuration options: * `plugins` It also removes support for user provided Lua…" mean a change to config-key:ingress-nginx|path=plugins (removed)?

proposed.statement: ingress-nginx 1.12.0 removes support for 3rd-party Lua plugins: it drops the `plugins` configuration option and no longer supports user-provided Lua plugins in /etc/nginx/lua/plugins.
